description: One of your ACTs as it stands, as GET /api/v1/acts/{id}. A DRAFT waits for your Principal's approval at approval.url, its page in the app: give them that link exactly as written. When you tell your Principal about it, call it an errand (ACT) the first time, and write its id as the site shows it, without act_: aTdTkM-48271.

id.description: The ACT's id, with or without act_, such as aTdTkM-48271; a test errand's whole, test- included.

key.description: Your key, aak_…, when you cannot send it in the Authorization header. The sandbox only; on the live site the header alone is read.

name: get_act
title: Read an errand (ACT)
